verdicts.why: Dar-Benn grabs the second bangle off Kamala during the fight at the Sun, after she has already opened the jump point with one band; she then joins the bands and explodes. The out needs the steal once the cause no longer carries it.
Rocket is confronted by the High Evolutionary, whom the other Guardians defeat; Rocket then spares him.
Groot grows wings and glides all three down; on landing Quill slams Theel against the ground, killing him, and cuts the code from his headpiece.
The Arête departs as Nebula, Drax and Mantis board it to rescue Quill and Groot, who then jump off; the three are captured aboard later, not taken there.

value.value: After Bullseye's attempt on his life at the Black & White Ball, Mayor Fisk demands a crackdown on every vigilante in the city, and then cuts the power to the city.

verdicts.why: In 'Straight to Hell' Fisk says the city needs a push and has the power to the entire city shut off, then turns it back on and declares martial law; the blackout is his doing, not chance.
Bullseye launches the glass paperweight at Vanessa; Fisk blocks it with his championship belt and a shard lodges in her temple. It was not thrown at Fisk.

verdicts.value: John King, suffocated in a sealed greenhouse.
verdicts.why: The oxygen runs out and King dies inside; Riri tells Parker he is already dead. 'Left to suffocate' still leaves his status open, so state the death.
Shalla-Bal is already in the list as silver-surfer; the app lists each person once per report (e.g. Skurge once in dc-ragnarok), so adding her ally file would list the same person twice.

value.now: Protesters killed as the Task Force breaks up the crowd.

verdicts.why: At the City Hall protest only Alan Saunders is killed; Javi Espinosa is struck down but alive. Fisk kills protesters later at the courthouse, a different report.
The rules define tabs but not where an averted future (the Horde Wakanda, which the Sacred Timeline never reaches once the axe is returned) is filed; that is a filing choice for the owner.
Tyrone is without his cloak (Tandy gives him her stolen hoodie instead), and outside the Roxxon facility he uses the Darkforce to absorb Connors.
In 'Group Therapy' Doctor Octopus, with Electro, breaks himself, Vulture, Shocker, Sandman and Rhino out of Ryker's Island together.
Settled by the owner: Marvel's B Earth numbers are used everywhere they exist.
WandaVision never shows the cover story; the wiki cites Agatha All Along episode 6 (and VisionQuest #1) for the incident being passed off as an Avengers training exercise gone wrong.

The escape closes episode 11, 'AKA Three Lives and Counting': Alisa learns of Malus's death on the news and escapes from prison.
